The client register, the client's icon, and the organisation tables

Pictures of the real platform and the real console with the changes drawn in. The logos are stand-ins, one wide and one square, shaped like El Abd's. Nothing here is built yet. The choices to make are gathered at the bottom.

1 · People register becomes Client register

The name changes on the rail and on the page. The harder question is the Forefront people in it.

Why Forefront people are in the register today

Access inside a client works from the register: a person needs a row there to sign in to that client and hold a seat. So when a consultant is added on Forefront team, the platform writes them a row here, marked FOREFRONT, with their seat (Super user or SMO team). They can't be edited here, only on Forefront team. The reason they're shown at all was so that everyone who can open this client's data is on one screen.

OptionWhat you see
A · As todayConsultants mixed in with the client's people, read-only, marked FOREFRONT.
B · Hidden, one click away RecommendedThe register lists the client's own people. A switch, Show Forefront team (2), brings the consultants back for a check of who can open this client. Nothing about their access changes; their rows are still there underneath.
C · Gone from the registerThe register never shows them. Forefront team is the only place they appear.

2 · The client's icon

The console's Home draws each client in a small square. A wide logo shrinks to an unreadable strip there. The Clients tab has room for the whole logo and keeps it.

Home today

Proposed

On Profile's Brand tab, under the mark, a new line: Its icon, with two choices. Use the mark is the default and suits a square logo. Its own icon uploads a square picture. When the mark is wide, the page says it would be too small to read in the square and shows both side by side, so the difference is visible before choosing. A client with a wide mark and no icon shows its initials on Home rather than a strip.

3 · The organisation tables can be changed, but nothing says so

Every row's details are changed through the ⋮ at the end of the row, then Edit details: the name, the short name in the navigation, the code, how it plans, its division, and its head and custodian (picked from the register). Nothing on the table itself looks editable, so it reads as a list you can only look at.

Today: ⋮ › Edit details

Proposed: the row itself opens it

A row lights up with Edit when the pointer is on it, and pressing anywhere on it opens the same details. The ⋮ keeps the rest: clear progress, clear the plan, retire. The same on Business units, Divisions and Functions.

4 · El Abd's capabilities

Checked against the record of the move: El Abd's five capabilities (C001 to C005) were moved into the company's own plan as pillars, beside its directions, with every code and owner kept. So they are planned, reported and scored exactly like the directions, and they are changed there. Setup › Capabilities on El Abd only lists them, read-only, with nothing to change.

OptionWhat happens
Remove the Setup page RecommendedCapabilities live in the plan, like directions, for every client. The demo's one old-style capability is moved the same way El Abd's were, so no client is left with the old kind.
Keep it as a read-only listAs now: a page that names them and sends you to the plan to change them.

What you would be agreeing to

  1. People register renamed Client register.
  2. Forefront people in it: B · hidden, one click away (recommended), A · as today, or C · gone.
  3. A client icon on the Brand tab (use the mark, or its own), used in Home's small squares; a wide mark with no icon shows initials there.
  4. On Business units, Divisions and Functions, pressing a row opens its details.
  5. Setup › Capabilities removed, and the demo's old-style capability moved into the plan like El Abd's (recommended), or kept as a read-only list.
